meta.description: Firefly: The Game – Story / Scenario cards

scenarioCards.name: First Time in the Captain's Chair

specialRules.name: Increased Enforcement
specialRules.text: Any time a player successfully completes an Illegal Job, they receive a Warrant Token.

specialRules.name: Safe Harbor
specialRules.text: The Alliance Cruiser may not be moved to a Haven. If a Card would move it to a Haven, the player to the right places it in an adjacent Sector.

specialRules.name: Friends in Low Places
specialRules.text: At any Haven, one Buy Action may both Buy Fuel and give Shore Leave. At your own Haven, Shore Leave is free and you may Load up to 4 free Fuel.

specialRules.name: Shared Inactive Jobs
specialRules.text: No personal Job hands. Deal only buys/sells with Contacts. Work any face-up Contact Job, then replace it. Discarded Jobs leave the game.

specialRules.name: Crime Pays
specialRules.text: Illegal Jobs pay +$1000 per current Warrant.

specialRules.name: Didn't sign on to Sight-see
specialRules.text: Completing a Legal Job Disgruntles all Wanted Crew.

specialRules.name: Nabbed!
specialRules.text: Alliance Cruiser contact removes your highest cost Crew member.

specialRules.name: The Sudden, Inevitable Betrayal
specialRules.text: When four Contact decks and discards are empty, the game ends. The last accepted Job is discarded.

specialRules.name: Settle Incomplete Jobs
specialRules.text: Pay the bank the Pay Value of Active and in-hand Jobs.

scenarioCards.name: It's All in Who You Know

gameLengthTokens.note: Printed Disgruntled Token wording is a typo. Timer tokens are Alliance Alert Tokens.

specialRules.name: Job Timer
specialRules.text: Each completed Job discards one Alliance Alert Token from the timer stack. Last token ends the game immediately.

goals.name: Gunfight at the Silverhold Corral
goals.fail: Kill 2 Crew. Attempt Botched & Warrant Issued.

goals.name: The Hills Have Eyes... And Guns!
goals.fail: Kill 3 Crew. Attempt Botched & Warrant Issued.

goals.name: The Quick and the Deadwood
goals.fail: Kill 4 Crew. Attempt Botched & Warrant Issued.

specialRules.name: Proving Your Worth
specialRules.text: Must be Solid with Patience and Mr. Universe to Work Goals. Warrants from Goals do not drop Solid with those Contacts.

specialRules.name: Last Call
specialRules.text: A player with a Goal Token may spend an Action to declare Last Call. Others take one more turn. Declarer does not go again.

specialRules.name: Settle Incomplete Jobs
specialRules.text: Pay the bank the Pay Value of Active and in-hand Jobs.

specialRules.name: Haven Sanctuary
specialRules.text: Ships at their Haven may not be boarded by Rivals.

specialRules.name: One Man's Trash...
specialRules.text: Work at your Haven to deliver sets of 4 Contraband, 4 Cargo, or 8 Parts. Each complete set grants a Goal Token.

scenarioCards.name: Awful Lonely in the Big Black

specialRules.name: Solo Game Turn
specialRules.text: Each of the 4 Actions at most once per turn. Fly ends the turn and spends a Game Length Token. After 20 tokens, one final turn with no Fly.

selectableGoals.name: The Ugly - No Rest for the Wicked

specialRules.name: Last Call
specialRules.text: A player with a Goal Token may declare Last Call. Others take one more turn.

goals.name: Making Friends in High & Low Places
Crying Wolf
goals.success: Move Alliance Cruiser to Valentine & Evade. Goal Complete.

goals.name: Belle of the Ball
goals.success: Intel Gathered. First player to gather the intel wins.

goals.name: Belly of the Beast
goals.note: Pirates & Bounty Hunters boarding test: 1-5 Botched, 6+ Boarding Successful, then Fight 10.
goals.success: Kill 1 Crew. Rescue Bound Fugitive. Evade and Warrant Issued. Goal Complete.

goals.name: Badger will make it all better...

bands.text: Pay $7,000 to Complete Goal or Attempt Botched
Pay $5,000 to Complete Goal or Attempt Botched

goals.name: Two Card Monty
goals.success: The crown is yours. First player to steal the crown wins.

specialRules.name: Smuggling Runs
specialRules.text: Work in an Alliance Sector with Contraband and Misbehave. Each card Proceeded Past takes 1 System Contraband.

specialRules.name: Special Delivery
specialRules.text: First player to Sell at least 3 Contraband to a Contact takes that Contact's $2000.

specialRules.name: Piracy Steals Goal Token
specialRules.text: Completing a Piracy Job may steal 1 Goal Token from the targeted Rival.

specialRules.name: The Hard Choices
specialRules.text: Earn a Goal Token for completing Piracy, Crime, Bounty delivery, or Smuggling.

scenarioCards.name: The Scavenger's 'Verse
scenarioCards.note: Deferred: checklist items are resolved by table consensus, not by engine rules.
flavorPoem: and a Hold with no spaces

specialRules.name: Rival Vote
specialRules.text: Rivals vote as each item is acquired. Majority declares Master of the Hunt.

specialRules.name: Limited Funds
specialRules.text: Spent credits return to the bank. Game ends when the bank is empty.

specialRules.name: Runaway Leader
specialRules.text: A player with more than half of all money available may claim victory. Four players on Standard need $16,000.

specialRules.name: Claim Destination Token
specialRules.text: Completing a Job in a Sector with a Goal Token lets you claim that token.
